description: This file contains automated API tests for the GetFieldsMeta functionality of a SuiteCRM system, specifically testing the 'meta/fields' API endpoints in version 8.

classes.name: GetFieldsMetaCest
classes.description: A test class using Codeception to verify the behavior of the API endpoint for retrieving field metadata in SuiteCRM's V8 API.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by logging in before each test.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Tests the API response for a valid endpoint, verifying that the response contains field metadata with correct structure.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Tests the API response for an invalid endpoint, verifying that access errors are correctly returned.

methods.name: shouldWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'shouldWork' test case.

methods.name: shouldNotWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'shouldNotWork' test case.
